PRS_unrest_update = {
	clamp_variable = { var = PRS_unrest_egypt min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = PRS_unrest_babylon min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = PRS_unrest_ionia min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = PRS_unrest_lydia min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = PRS_unrest_bactria min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { PRS_unrest_avg = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { PRS_unrest_avg = PRS_unrest_egypt }
	add_to_variable = { PRS_unrest_avg = PRS_unrest_babylon }
	add_to_variable = { PRS_unrest_avg = PRS_unrest_ionia }
	add_to_variable = { PRS_unrest_avg = PRS_unrest_lydia }
	add_to_variable = { PRS_unrest_avg = PRS_unrest_bactria }
	divide_variable = { PRS_unrest_avg = 5 }
	set_variable = { PRS_dm_stab = PRS_unrest_avg }
	multiply_variable = { PRS_dm_stab = -0.002 }
	add_to_variable = { PRS_dm_stab = 0.03 }
	set_variable = { PRS_dm_pp = PRS_unrest_avg }
	multiply_variable = { PRS_dm_pp = -0.003 }
	add_to_variable = { PRS_dm_pp = 0.05 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}
